cards.card_text: He asks Job, "Can you fathom the deep things of God or discover the limits of the Almighty?"
cards.verse_text: Can you fathom the deep things of God or discover the limits of the Almighty?
cards.snippet: Can you fathom the deep things of God or discover the limits of the Almighty?

cards.card_text: True or false: the Teacher says people can fathom all of God's work from beginning to end.
cards.verse_text: He has also set eternity in the hearts of men, yet they cannot fathom the work that God has done from beginning to end.
cards.snippet: …has also set eternity in the hearts of men, yet they cannot fathom the work that God has done from beginning to end.

cards.card_text: Then he looks at everything that exists and asks, "Who can fathom it?" Friend, I've been asking that about the flour on the BACK of my apron for years.

cards.verse_text: They took soundings and found that the water was twenty fathoms deep.
cards.snippet: They took soundings and found that the water was twenty fathoms deep.

cards.card_text: After a reading of twenty fathoms, the sailors go a little farther, and the next sounding reads ___ fathoms.
cards.verse_text: They took soundings and found that the water was twenty fathoms deep.
cards.snippet: They took soundings and found that the water was twenty fathoms deep.

cards.card_text: Then Paul cranks it up: what if he has the gift of prophecy, can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge, and has faith that can move mountains?
cards.verse_text: If I have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have absolute faith so as to move mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.
